title: Frontend: Install and configure shadcn/ui component library
description: Initialize shadcn/ui in the existing Vite + React + Tailwind project and install all component primitives that will be used throughout the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Core components installed: Button, Input, Label, Card, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Badge, Progress, Avatar, DropdownMenu, Tooltip, Separator, Skeleton, ScrollArea, Select, Checkbox, Textarea, Switch, Form
Tailwind CSS configured with shadcn/ui theme tokens (CSS variables)
Dark mode variant configured in tailwind.config.js
A test page renders a Button component without errors

steps.details: Run: npx shadcn@latest init. When prompted: style=Default, base color=Slate, CSS variables=Yes, path aliases configured. This creates components.json and updates tailwind.config.js and src/index.css.

Run in one command: npx shadcn@latest add button input label card dialog sheet tabs badge progress avatar dropdown-menu tooltip separator skeleton scroll-area select checkbox textarea switch form toast sonner popover command.
In tailwind.config.js, verify darkMode: ['class'] is set. This allows toggling dark mode via className on the html element.
In src/App.tsx, temporarily render <Button>Test</Button>. Start dev server — verify button renders with correct shadcn/ui styles and no console errors.
